prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Journey", "Select how you would like to create and adopt your virtual desktop pet.", "Path Options"]
1: ["Set Your Pet Personality", "Choose traits for your companion to shape how it interacts on your desktop.", "Traits"]
2: []
3: ["Name Your Companion", "Give your new pet a name to make official ownership documents.", "Pet Name"]
4: ["Welcome Back to Desktop Pets", "Sign in with your registered account to restore your existing pets and progress.", "Use the same email or method you used during your previous setup."]
5: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "We are preparing your pet graphics and desktop behaviors. This will only take a moment."]
6: ["Minimize the window anytime. We'll alert you when your pet is ready!"]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your companion details before completing adoption.", "Pet Preview"]
8: ["Quick Tip: Press Alt+P anytime to open pet controls or hide your pet from your desktop.", "Press Alt+P to summon controls"]
9: ["Step 1 of 5: Choose your creation path to get started."]
